content.short: Whitewallet is a secure non-custodial multichain wallet that makes Web3 simple for everyday use.
content.description: Whitewallet is a secure, non-custodial multichain wallet that lets you store, send, and exchange digital assets while maintaining full control of your money. It supports a broad set of networks, enabling seamless asset movement across chains without requiring specialized tools or technical steps. The wallet also offers straightforward access to a wide range of blockchain apps and services, making Web3 usable in everyday life without needing technical expertise.
